source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester asks for three independent random complex photographic concepts that use the supplied portrait to test researched source keywords in actual images. This arm independently drew a coastal bus shelter out of four travel/weather alternatives using recorded seed 5082448499392265687. I authored a fictional adult traveler rescuing a soaked ticket as a bus approaches. This adulthood, location, blouse, posture, paper and vehicle are scene choices, not claims about the reference person or requesting-user requirements. The viewer should feel a small setback becoming manageable through a readable hand action and an emerging onward journey. Seven original reference-audit keywords drive distinct chosen pixel expectations: satin surface, local fabric adhesion, discrete water beads, wet separated hair, wet-skin highlights, glass condensation versus droplets, and natural skin texture. Saved sensual 1 remains a subtle supporting appeal through attentive human presence and soft light; fetish 0 and surreal 0 add no treatment, creativity 1 keeps a plausible travel interruption. Reference scope is visible face and hair guidance, without identity, age, biography, personality, outfit or body-shape claims. Staging is observational but deliberately clear enough to see material owners and the rescued ticket. Authorial scene details remain editable on open dimensions and the test plan does not become a requester lock.
subject: A fictional traveler with face and hair guided by the supplied portrait; fictional adulthood is an authorial choice.
setting: A small glass coastal bus shelter and wet road at blue dusk after a squall.
event: The traveler lifts a soaked curled ticket out of a bench puddle using a dry cardboard folder and steadies its dry corner while a bus approaches.
visual_priorities: The referenced facial proportions and dark wispy bob remain legible while the traveler attends to the incoming bus.
The two hands, dry folder, curled ticket and puddle make protection of a fragile travel object understandable.
Wet hair, beaded skin, locally adhering satin and misted versus rain-beaded glass have distinct owners and visibly different surface behavior.
Warm shelter light and paired bus headlamps connect the travel interruption with an immediate next possibility.
baseline_prompt_en: A complex photographic concept makes material changes visible around a woman guided by the visible face and hair of the supplied portrait. Her softly rounded face, dark eyes, natural lips, and chin-length dark bob with fine wispy bangs retain the reference's visible proportions. This is a quiet travel photograph at a glass coastal bus shelter after a sudden squall, at blue dusk. She sits slightly forward on the dry rear edge of an aluminum bench, both feet planted on the shelter floor. Her left palm supports an open cardboard travel folder horizontally above her knees; its dry underside has lifted a curled paper ticket away from a puddle on the bench. Her right thumb and index finger gently pinch the ticket's dry upper corner. The intact printed portion rests on the folder, while the saturated lower end curls downward with a single drop suspended beneath it. Both hands and their separate objects are fully visible. She has just raised her head toward the approaching bus outside the open side of the shelter, keeping her hands steady; the tension around her mouth has begun to ease as the paired headlamps approach. A muted blue satin blouse has smooth continuous highlights on its dry fabric, while darker rain-soaked patches adhere to the shoulder and waist contours with small gathered wrinkles. Wet separated hair strands lie against her forehead and cheek. Distinct round water droplets bead on her forearm and collarbone, catching small sparkling points of light on damp skin with fine pores and natural unevenness. An opaque patch of condensation on the inner glass contrasts with rounded rain beads and narrow runnels on the outer pane. A warm canopy lamp grazes her face, hands, wet skin and satin, while the road and glass keep the cold blue of rain. Frame from head to knees at a three-quarter angle, the camera at chest height with natural 50 mm perspective. Her face and working hands are sharp; the approaching bus retains recognizable structure behind the glass. The rescued ticket, damp surfaces, and arriving vehicle make this pause between setback and onward travel legible in one photograph.
